cases.situation: Ordered a 3-seat sofa from Hartwell Home, order HH-40718, delivered yesterday with a big tear in the back cushion. Paid $1,240. Want it fixed without a war.
cases.reply:
Hi,
Order HH-40718, placed 2 September, delivered yesterday: the grey Arlo 3-seat sofa arrived with a 10cm tear along the back of the left cushion (photos attached). I'd like a replacement cushion sent out, and I'm happy for your team to collect the damaged one when it's delivered. Could you confirm the plan by Friday?
Thanks,
Owen Park, 555-0142
cases.note: Reference and date first, the fault factually, one specific ask and a deadline. Asking for the cushion, not the whole sofa, is proportionate and easy to approve.

cases.situation: 在某外卖平台点了一份168的烤鸭套餐，送到的时候少了一份鸭架汤和两张饼，打商家电话没人接。想在平台上找客服。
cases.reply: 你好，订单号 2026092811438，今天中午12:10送达，168元的烤鸭双人套餐少了鸭架汤和两份薄饼（照片已上传）。我12:20和12:35各打了一次商家电话，都没人接。希望能退还缺失部分的费用，或者补送一份，两个都可以。麻烦今天之内给个答复，谢谢！
cases.note: 订单号、事实、已经尝试过的、一个明确的要求、期限，客服拿着就能处理。

cases.situation: Emailed my gym (FitCore) twice to cancel my membership after moving cities, they keep charging me $49/month. Their first reply was just a script saying cancellations need to be in person. I moved 400 miles away.
cases.reply: Thanks for your reply. I don't think that resolves it, since I moved to Portland on 1 August, 400 miles from any FitCore branch, and sent my written cancellation on 3 August (attached). I'd like this escalated to a manager. To restate: I'm asking you to cancel membership #FC-22817 and refund the $49 charges from September and October. I'd rather settle this directly than through a card dispute, and I'm confident we can.
cases.note: If this gets another scripted no, tell them the chargeback date once, then file it.

cases.situation: We had my dad's 70th birthday dinner at Rosalind's on Saturday, party of 8, and booked the private room back in August with a $200 deposit. They sat us in the main dining room next to the kitchen door and nobody explained why.
cases.reply:
Hi,
We had a party of eight at Rosalind's on Saturday 26 September for my dad's 70th birthday, booked in August with a $200 deposit for the private room (confirmation attached). When we arrived we were seated in the main dining room by the kitchen door, and nobody told us why. The food and our servers were lovely; the room was the thing we'd paid extra for. I'd like the $200 deposit refunded. Could you let me know by Friday 2 October?
Thanks,
Laura Chen, 555-0187
cases.note: Credit what was good in one clause, then ask for the one thing that maps to the failure: the deposit, not the whole bill.

cases.situation: 家里装修，卫生间瓷砖9月21日铺完，没几天就发现有三块空鼓。27号和28号两次微信找项目经理孙经理都没回。合同写了保修一年，想直接给装修公司客服发个正式的投诉。
cases.reply: 您好，我是翠湖花园3栋1802的业主赵磊，合同号 JZ-2026-0715。卫生间瓷砖9月21日铺完，9月27日发现有三块空鼓，照片和视频附后。9月27日和28日我两次微信联系项目经理孙经理，目前都没有回复。按合同约定的一年保修，请安排师傅上门，重新铺贴这三块瓷砖。希望在10月9日周五前确定上门时间。我的电话是 138 1077 4521，谢谢。
cases.note: Written escalation over a silent contact: cite the contract clause and dated attempts so the next reader can act without asking.

cases.situation: Just checked into the Marlowe Hotel in Boston for 3 nights for a conference. Room 614 reeks of cigarette smoke and I booked non-smoking. Heading down to the front desk now, what do I say?
cases.reply: Hi, I'm Priya Nair, I've just checked into room 614 for three nights, out on Friday. I booked a non-smoking room, and 614 smells strongly of cigarette smoke, enough that I can't sleep in it. I'd like to move to a non-smoking room tonight, ideally within the hour since I have an early start. I'm happy to wait here while you check.
cases.note: In person the same structure works out loud: who you are, the fact, the specific fix and a time, then stay calm and stay at the desk.

cases.situation: My language app (Lingora) auto-renewed my annual plan for $119 on Sept 26. I forgot to cancel, which is on me, and I haven't opened it since June. I want to ask for a refund without pretending it was their fault.
cases.reply:
Hi,
My annual Lingora Plus plan, account maya.reyes@mailbox.com, auto-renewed on 26 September for $119. That's my mistake: I meant to cancel before the renewal and missed it. I haven't used the app since June and haven't opened it since the charge. Could you cancel the plan and refund the $119 as a one-off? I'd be grateful for a reply by Friday 2 October.
Thanks,
Maya Reyes
cases.note: When the slip is partly yours, say so in one line; owning it is what makes a goodwill refund easy to grant.

cases.situation: Returned a $219 pair of hiking boots to Trailhead Outfitters on Sept 4, tracking shows they got them Sept 8. I emailed on Sept 15 and Sept 22 asking where my refund is and got no reply to either. Order TO-88412.
cases.reply:
Hi,
Order TO-88412: I returned the Ridgeline hiking boots on 4 September, and tracking shows you received them on 8 September (screenshot attached). I emailed on 15 and 22 September about the $219 refund and haven't had a reply. Please refund the $219 to my original card. If it hasn't been issued by Friday 9 October, I'll raise a chargeback with my card provider.
Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz, 555-0163
cases.note: After two unanswered emails, stop repeating the ask: name the next step and its date once, then take it if the date passes.

cases.situation: My Skyvale Airways flight from Lisbon to Amsterdam on Sept 18, booking ref K7Q2MD, was cancelled the night before for 'operational reasons'. They rebooked me the next evening, I paid €142 for a hotel near the airport, and I missed a paid day of a conference. I want to claim what I'm owed.
cases.reply: Hello, booking reference K7Q2MD. My flight from Lisbon to Amsterdam on 18 September was cancelled the evening before for operational reasons, and I was rebooked on the next evening's flight. I paid €142 for a hotel near the airport that night (receipt attached). I'm requesting the €400 compensation due under EU Regulation 261/2004 for a cancellation with less than 14 days' notice on a route of this distance, plus reimbursement of the €142 hotel. Please confirm within 14 days. Thank you, Hannah Weiss, hannah.weiss@mailbox.org
cases.note: The missed conference day isn't covered by EU261, so leave it out: a claim that asks only for what's due is the easiest one to approve.

cases.situation: 网上买的空气净化器，订单号8820417736，9月17日签收，今天开机就报E3故障。客服回复说过了7天无理由，只能寄回厂家维修，要等30天左右。我想要换新，不想吵架。
cases.reply: 您好，谢谢回复。寄修解决不了我的问题：订单号8820417736的空气净化器9月17日签收，9月29日开机报E3故障，签收还不到15天。按三包规定，15天内出现性能故障可以直接换货。麻烦转给主管或售后专员处理，我的要求还是换一台新机。希望10月8日（周四）前能给我答复，我更希望和你们直接解决这件事。
cases.note: 第一次被话术拒绝，只升级一次：重申订单事实、依据和一个要求，给个期限，不在第一次升级里提差评或投诉平台。
